name: IDLE
title: Scheduled order confirmed
description: Scheduled order confirmed, the supplier will see the order in driver app by the time specified

name: ACCEPTED
title: Once supplier accepts the order
description: Once supplier accepts the order, the order status will be changed to ACCEPTED

name: IN PROCESS
title: The supplier collects the package at the pickup location
description: When the supplier collects the package at the pickup location, he will click “Pick up” and the order status will be changed to IN PROCESS

name: COMPLETED
title: The supplier completes the order
description: When the supplier completes the order, the order status will be changed to COMPLETED (It does not mean the package is delivered. Check the delivery status description below)

name: CANCELLED
title: When an order is canceled for any reason
description: The supplier cancels the order / The user cancels the order / there is no suppliers accepting order after a certain period of time (depending on service type), the order status will be changed to CANCELLED

name: IN_RETURN
title: In return the package
description: When supplier return the package to pickup location in case failed delivery

name: RETURNED
title: Return the package
description: When supplier return the package to pickup location in case failed delivery
